    var d = document.getElementById('__bundler_err') || p.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));

    // document mints the blobs for its OWN frames, obtaining page text

    // its direct parent (which, for every document the publisher's own
    // runtime minted, is another publisher document) and only ACCEPTS
    // text from that direct parent; requests from below are honored only

    // protocol would hand page uuids to that ancestor and accept forged

    // contexts such as a sandboxed preview iframe) — location.origin is

    // is sandboxed, which would misgate every opaque chain.

var(--font-mono);letter-spacing:var(--tracking-caption);text-transform:uppercase}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* SpotlightSearch.io — Spacing, Grid & Radii\n   Whitespace is part of the brand. One idea per page. */\n:root{\n  --sp-0:0;    /* @kind spacing */\n  --sp-1:4px;\n  --sp-2:8px;\n  --sp-3:12px;\n  --sp-4:16px;\n  --sp-5:24px;\n  --sp-6:32px;\n  --sp-7:48px;\n  --sp-8:64px;\n  --sp-9:96px;\n  --sp-10:128px;\n  --sp-11:160px;\n\n  /* Layout — A4 portrait reference grid: 18mm margins, 6 flexible columns */\n  --layout-margin:18mm;      /* @kind spacing */\n  --layout-columns:6;        /* @kind other */\n  --layout-gutter:var(--sp-5);\n  --content-max:1200px;      /* @kind spacing */\n  --measure:60ch;            /* @kind spacing */\n\n  /* Corner radii — institutional restraint, never bubbly */\n  --radius-xs:4px;\n  --radius-sm:6px;\n  --radius-md:10px;\n  --radius-lg:16px;\n  --radius-xl:24px;\n  --radius-pill:999px;\n\n  /* Clear space — protect the logo by the height of its focal dot */\n  --logo-clearspace:1em;\n  --logo-min-print:32mm;  /* @kind spacing */\n  --logo-min-digital:120px;\n  --mark-min:24px;\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* SpotlightSearch.io — Effects: borders, shadows, glow, blur, motion\n   Calm by default. The spotlight glow is the signature light — used sparingly. */\n:root{\n  /* Borders */\n  --border-hairline:1px solid var(--ss-ink-200);\n  --border-dark:1px solid var(--ss-ui-line);\n  --border-signal:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 60%,transparent);\n\n  /* Elevation — soft, cool, restrained */\n  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(12,14,16,.06);\n  --shadow-md:0 8px 24px rgba(12,14,16,.10);\n  --shadow-lg:0 24px 64px rgba(12,14,16,.18);\n  --shadow-dark:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45);\n\n  /* Spotlight glow — the signature halo (aqua). One or two per surface. */\n  --glow-aqua:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 40%,transparent),0 0 24px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 35%,transparent);\n  --glow-aqua-soft:0 0 40px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 22%,transparent);\n  --glow-gold:0 0 24px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-gold) 30%,transparent);\n\n  /* Radial spotlight wash for hero/section backgrounds */\n  --spotlight-wash:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% -10%,color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 12%,transparent) 0%,transparent 55%);\n\n  /* Glass / blur — used only for instrument overlays on dark */\n  --blur-panel:blur(14px);   /* @kind other */\n  --panel-glass:color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-ui-card) 72%,transparent);\n\n  /* Motion — inevitable, never bouncy. State, don't shout. */\n  --ease-standard:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);  /* @kind other */\n  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);      /* @kind other */\n  --dur-fast:120ms;   /* @kind other */\n  --dur-base:200ms;   /* @kind other */\n  --dur-slow:420ms;   /* @kind other */\n\n  /* Interaction states */\n  --hover-lift:translateY(-1px);  /* @kind other */\n  --press-scale:scale(.985);      /* @kind other */\n  --hover-tint:color-mix(in oklch,var(--ss-aqua) 8%,transparent);\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* SpotlightSearch.io — Global stylesheet entry.\n   Consumers link THIS file only. Component extends DCLogic {\n  state = { page: null, mode: null, cat: 'harassment' };\n  map = {\n    cover:1, problem:1, platform:1, integrations:1, migration:1,\n    command:1, financials:1, payroll:1, analytics:1, compliance:1,\n    tonight:1, booking:1, scheduling:1, boxoffice:1, bar:1, inventory:1, workorders:1, cases:1,\n    myshift:1, timeclock:1, swaps:1, report:1, mypay:1,\n    bookings:1, opencalls:1, venueportal:1, contracts:1, settlements:1, rider:1,\n    listing:1, checkout:1, ticket:1, purchasing:1, receiving:1,\n    door:1, admin:1\n  };\n  _go = {};\n  goTo(p){\n    this.setState({ page: p });\n    const el = document.getElementById('ss-main');\n    if (el) el.scrollTop = 0;\n  }\n  renderVals(){\n    const cur = this.state.page ?? (this.props.startPage || 'cover');\n    const mode = this.state.mode ?? (this.props.disclosureDefault || 'anonymous');\n    const nv = {}, pg = {}, go = {};\n    Object.keys(this.map).forEach(k => {\n      const on = k === cur;\n      nv[k] = {\n        bg: on ? 'rgba(6,229,199,.10)' : 'transparent',\n        fg: on ? '#2FE0C4' : '#8A939A'\n      };\n      pg[k] = on;\n      if (!this._go[k]) this._go[k] = () => this.goTo(k);\n      go[k] = this._go[k];\n    });\n    const modes = ['named','confidential','anonymous'];\n    const rm = {}, setMode = {};\n    modes.forEach(m => {\n      const on = m === mode;\n      rm[m] = {\n        bg: on ? 'rgba(6,229,199,.09)' : '#0F1214',\n        bd: on ? 'rgba(47,224,196,.42)' : '#23282C',\n        fg: on ? '#2FE0C4' : '#EAF0F0'\n      };\n      if (!this._go['m_'+m]) this._go['m_'+m] = () => this.setState({ mode: m });\n      setMode[m] = this._go['m_'+m];\n    });\n\n    const cats = ['maintenance','interpersonal','harassment','guest'];\n    const ct = {}, setCat = {};\n    cats.forEach(c => {\n      const on = c === this.state.cat;\n      ct[c] = {\n        bg: on ? 'rgba(6,229,199,.07)' : '#0F1214',\n        bd: on ? 'rgba(47,224,196,.38)' : '#23282C'\n      };\n      if (!this._go['c_'+c]) this._go['c_'+c] = () => this.setState({ cat: c });\n      setCat[c] = this._go['c_'+c];\n    });\n\n    const performerPages = ['bookings','opencalls','venueportal','contracts','settlements','rider'];\n    const isPerformer = performerPages.indexOf(cur) !== -1;\n\n    return {\n      nv, pg, go, rm, setMode, ct, setCat,\n      isPerformer, isVenue: !isPerformer,\n      isNamed: mode === 'named',\n      isConfidential: mode === 'confidential',\n      isAnonymous: mode === 'anonymous'\n    };\n  }\n}\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"
